dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent type of complete numerical-refinement runs. Its constructor D016 packages the matrices, vectors, iterates, precision functions, polynomial factor, exact-system assumptions, rounding-error models, inner-solver certificates, and auxiliary asymptotic bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is universally quantified over one such run, so every condition packaged by its constructor is an implicit assumption of the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's second field, the n by n real matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A defines the residual-based backward errors, the condition factor, and the packaged numerical model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's fourth field, the right-hand-side vector b in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: b occurs in the normwise relative residual defining the first error recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's fifth field, the exact solution vector xExact in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reference vector in the relative forward-error recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's sixth field, the family xHat(i,t) of computed n-vectors indexed by iteration i and parameter t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target compares the errors of xHat(i+1,t) and xHat(i,t) for every natural-number iteration i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normwise relative residual η(A,b,x) = ||b-Ax||₂/(||A||_F ||x||₂+||b||₂).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the error quantity on both sides of the first recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function t ↦ P(n,n) uHigh(t), where P is the run's polynomial factor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the additive first-order term in the backward-error recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For scale s and functions lhs,rhs, it asserts that there exists a remainder r with r = O_l(s²) such that eventually along l, lhs(t) ≤ rhs(t)+|r(t)|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each of the two conclusions is precisely such a second-order-relaxed eventual inequality, separately for every iteration.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The relative forward error E(x,xHat) = ||xHat-x||₂/||x||₂.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With x=xExact, it is the error quantity on both sides of the second recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function t ↦ P(n,n) uHigh(t) κ_F(A), where κ_F(A)=||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the additive first-order term in the forward-error recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function λ(t)=P(n,n) uLow(t) κ_F(A).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is assumed to tend to zero and eventually lie in [0,1), and it multiplies the current error in both recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The total scale s(t)=uHigh(t)+uLow(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both unspecified remainders are required to be O_l(s²).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: For λ, the conjunction λ→0 along l and, eventually along l, 0≤λ(t)<1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the explicit contraction-factor hypothesis hLambda.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of n by n real matrices, represented as Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions and scalar field of A and Ainv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's third field, the n by n real matrix Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters κ_F(A), λ, the forward-error additive term, and the packaged inverse assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a run. It requires 0<n; matrices A,Ainv; vectors b,xExact; iterate, residual, correction, residual-error, and update-error families; nonnegative precision functions uHigh,uLow with uHigh≤uLow and both tending to zero; a nonnegative-coefficient polynomial P; b≠0; bijectivity of A; both inverse identities for A and Ainv; AxExact=b; n uHigh(t)<1; exact residual and update decompositions; componentwise residual- and update-rounding bounds; one inner-solver certificate per iteration; and four auxiliary O((uHigh+uLow)²)-relaxed inequalities controlling iterate norms, residual/update perturbations, and update error.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies all data and hidden assumptions carried by the run binder, including the positivity of n and the exact-system and rounding models used to establish the two recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's thirteenth field, its bivariate polynomial factor P.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its value P(n,n) appears in λ and both additive error terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's eleventh field, the nonnegative high-precision unit-roundoff function uHigh(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes to the scale and to both additive first-order error terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's twelfth field, the nonnegative low-precision unit-roundoff function uLow(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes to the scale and determines the contraction factor λ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real n-vectors, represented as functions Fin n → Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the type of b, xExact, all iterates, and all vector-valued errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius condition factor κ_F(A)=||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in λ and in the additive forward-error term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normwise relative residual ||b-AxHat||₂/(||A||_F ||xHat||₂+||b||₂).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: LocalDef006 delegates to this quantity, so it gives the exact mathematical content of the first error measure.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evaluation of the finite bivariate polynomial P at natural numbers n,k: P(n,k)=Σ_i Σ_j c_ij n^i k^j, using real casts of n and k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target uses the computed constant P(n,n), not merely an unspecified asymptotic constant.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that a remainder is Big-O along l of the square of the supplied scale.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact second-order requirement on each existential remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm ||x||₂=(Σ_i x_i²)^(1/2) on R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines every vector norm in the backward and forward errors and in the run assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The smallness condition n u<1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires n uHigh(t)<1 for every t, ensuring the packaged γ_n(uHigh) expression has a positive denominator.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type of per-iteration inner-solver certificates parameterized by the filter, scale, system, current and next iterates, residual, correction, low precision, and polynomial.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run contains one such certificate for every iteration; its constructor is only partially displayed, so its complete hidden assumptions cannot be exhaustively translated.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: A finite bivariate polynomial datum with natural degrees and real coefficients; constructor D038 requires every coefficient to be nonnegative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the polynomial whose exact value P(n,n) scales all first-order bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient function c_ij of a polynomial datum, indexed through its two finite degree ranges.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These coefficients determine P(n,n).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The polynomial datum's second degree, degreeK.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the range of the second finite sum in polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The polynomial datum's first degree, degreeN.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the range of the first finite sum in polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard factor γ_n(u)=n u/(1-n u).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the componentwise residual-rounding bound packaged in the run, but not explicitly in the final recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a square real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines ||A||_F, ||Ainv||_F, κ_F(A), and the denominator of the backward error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that the linear map x↦Ax on R^n is bijective.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires A to be nonsingular.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Square matrix-vector multiplication, (Ax)_i=Σ_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines residuals, the exact equation, inverse identities, and several packaged error terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The residual vector b-Ax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Euclidean norm is the numerator of the backward error.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for an inner-solver certificate using a key dimension q with 0<q≤n, basis and Hessenberg matrices, an inexact Arnoldi relation, residual casting, perturbed products and least-squares data, correction formation, nonnegative vanishing error parameters, lower-gain bounds, a near-singularity condition for an augmented matrix when q<n, polynomial-factor bounds, and bounded backward/forward factors. The displayed type ends with omitted premises and conclusions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It explains part of the per-iteration certificate hidden inside the run, but the ellipses prevent a complete account of that certificate's contribution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor making a polynomial datum from two natural degrees, a rectangular coefficient table, and proofs that all coefficients are nonnegative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees that the run's polynomial factor has finite degree and nonnegative coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of m by k real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the rectangular matrices occurring only in the inner-solver certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: The augmented matrix [φb, C], whose first column is φb and whose remaining columns are C.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the inner-solver certificate's conditional near-singularity assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that y is a Euclidean least-squares minimizer for Ay≈b: ||b-Ay||₂≤||b-Az||₂ for every z.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains the least-squares solution inside each inner-solver certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: A lower-gain bound σ||x||₂≤||Ax||₂ holding for every x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies basis and image lower bounds in the inner-solver certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that there exists a unit vector x with ||Ax||₂≤δ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the inner-solver certificate's conditional near-singularity bound for an augmented matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a rectangular real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures matrix perturbations and gains inside the inner-solver certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Rectangular matrix multiplication, (AB)_ij=Σ_r A_ir B_rj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the basis-times-Hessenberg product in the packaged Arnoldi relation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Rectangular matrix-vector multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines least-squares residuals, correction formation, and gain conditions inside the inner-solver certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Left multiplication of an n by k matrix B by the square matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents A applied to a basis matrix in the Arnoldi and product-error assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul

dependency_coverage.name: Real

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard addition operation on natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HAdd instance induced by an ordinary Add instance.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HMul instance induced by an ordinary Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects elaborated HMul calls to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The instance interpreting each natural literal n as that same natural number.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation inherited from a division-inverse monoid.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each LocalDef008 conclusion introduces an existential remainder function.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Eventually

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Tendsto
dependency_coverage.meaning: Filter convergence: the image filter under a function is below the target filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses convergence of λ, uHigh, uLow, and several packaged perturbation functions to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite index type {0,…,n-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes all vector coordinates and matrix rows and columns.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms relative residuals, relative forward errors, and auxiliary ratios.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded subtraction operation supplied by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms b-Ax, xHat-xExact, and other perturbation differences.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The overloaded non-strict order relation ≤.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every non-strict real or natural inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets positivity and strict contraction or smallness conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real or structural occurrences of one in bounds and denominators.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction on dependent function spaces.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes vector subtraction coordinatewise in residual and forward-error expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The uniform-space structure induced by a pseudometric space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates in constructing the standard topology used for real convergence.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive-group structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports subtraction, negation, and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplication, inverse, and total division structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all divisions in the defined error quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard ≤ relation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the mathematical ordering in all eventual error inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard < relation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the strict real ordering in contraction and positivity assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the upper bound in 0≤λ<1 and appears in denominators such as 1-nu.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard real subtraction a-b=a+(-b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets scalar differences in residual-related definitions and γ_n.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the convergence limit and lower bound for nonnegative quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard lattice structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group, it defines real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard real metric structure with distance |x-y|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It induces the topology in which λ and precision functions tend to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The topological-space structure induced by a uniform space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real neighborhood filters used in Tendsto statements.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real and vector zeros in convergence, positivity, and nonzero assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Absolute value, defined as max(a,-a) in a lattice-ordered additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The eventual inequalities permit an additive |remainder(t)|, and absolute values also occur in componentwise bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HDiv instance induced by an ordinary Div instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects elaborated division calls to standard real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HSub instance induced by an ordinary Sub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects elaborated subtraction calls to pointwise vector or standard real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: nhds
dependency_coverage.meaning: The neighborhood filter of a point in a topological space.

dependency_coverage.name: Asymptotics.IsBigO
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard filter-based Big-O relation between normed functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires each remainder to be bounded in magnitude by a constant multiple of |s(t)²| eventually along l.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the exact system, inverse identities, and exact decompositions packaged in a run.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables sums over all coordinates in norms, matrix products, and polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It realizes coordinate sums, matrix products, squared Euclidean norms, and polynomial evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All coordinate and coefficient sums range over their complete finite index sets.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow

dependency_coverage.name: Ne

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat

binders: A nonbottom filter l on ι.

A run containing an n-dimensional real linear system, exact and computed data, precision functions, rounding models, inner-solver certificates, and auxiliary asymptotic estimates as specified by LocalDef001 and constructor D016.
The natural iteration index i is universally quantified separately in each of the two conclusions.
hypotheses: The run packages 0<n, square real matrices A and Ainv, nonzero b∈R^n, an exact solution xExact∈R^n, and computed iterates xHat(i,t)∈R^n.
The map x↦Ax is bijective, Ainv is a two-sided inverse of A, and AxExact=b.
The functions uHigh,uLow:ι→R are everywhere nonnegative, satisfy uHigh(t)≤uLow(t), and both tend to zero along l; additionally n uHigh(t)<1 for every t.
The run packages exact residual and update decompositions together with their stated componentwise rounding-error bounds.
For every iteration, the run supplies an inner-solver certificate of type LocalDef027; the packet displays only part of that certificate's constructor.
For every iteration, the run assumes second-order-relaxed eventual bounds ||xHat_i||₂≼||xHat_(i+1)||₂ and ||xHat_(i+1)||₂≼||xExact||₂, where the relaxation scale is s=uHigh+uLow.

For every iteration, the run also assumes second-order-relaxed bounds on (||residualError_i||₂+||A updateError_i||₂)/(||b||₂+||A||_F||xHat_(i+1)||₂) by P(n,n)uHigh and on ||updateError_i||₂/||xExact||₂ by P(n,n)uHigh κ_F(A).
For λ(t)=P(n,n)uLow(t)κ_F(A), λ tends to zero along l and eventually satisfies 0≤λ(t)<1.
conclusions: For every i∈N, there exists a real-valued remainder r_i^η with r_i^η=O_l(s²) such that eventually along l, η(A,b,xHat(i+1,t))≤λ(t)η(A,b,xHat(i,t))+P(n,n)uHigh(t)+|r_i^η(t)|.
For every i∈N, there exists a real-valued remainder r_i^E with r_i^E=O_l(s²) such that eventually along l, E(xExact,xHat(i+1,t))≤λ(t)E(xExact,xHat(i,t))+P(n,n)uHigh(t)κ_F(A)+|r_i^E(t)|.
mathematical_definitions: Vectors in R^n are functions Fin n→R, and square matrices are functions Fin n→Fin n→R.
For a vector x, ||x||₂=(Σ_j x_j²)^(1/2). Matrix norms ||A||_F and ||Ainv||_F are Frobenius norms.
The polynomial factor is P(a,b)=Σ_i Σ_j c_ij a^i b^j over its finite degree ranges, with all c_ij≥0; the theorem uses the exact value P(n,n).
Writing f≼g at scale s means that some remainder r=O_l(s²) exists and eventually f(t)≤g(t)+|r(t)|.
translation.proposition_plain_english: Given any packaged n-dimensional refinement run satisfying its exact-system, inverse, rounding-error, inner-solver, and auxiliary asymptotic assumptions, suppose λ(t)=P(n,n)uLow(t)||Ainv||_F||A||_F tends to zero and is eventually a number in [0,1). Then, at every natural-number iteration, both the normwise relative residual and the relative forward error at the next iterate obey a one-step contraction recurrence with multiplier λ. The backward-error recurrence has additive term P(n,n)uHigh, while the forward-error recurrence has additive term P(n,n)uHigh||Ainv||_F||A||_F. Each inequality holds eventually along the filter and has its own additive absolute remainder that is Big-O of (uHigh+uLow)².

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although n is syntactically any natural number, constructing a run requires 0<n. With the displayed constructor as the only constructor, the theorem has no run instance at n=0 and is therefore vacuous there.
The filter l is arbitrary apart from being nonbottom; the result is not restricted to an ordinary sequential or real-parameter limit.
Both conclusions are eventual statements along l, not pointwise inequalities for every t.
The result quantifies over every i∈N with no finite upper bound, but it does not assert convergence as i→∞, uniformity in i, or a closed-form multi-step estimate.
The two conclusions may use different remainder functions, and each remainder may depend on i.
Big-O controls the remainder only asymptotically up to an unspecified constant; the inequality adds its absolute value and is one-sided.

Lean's real division is total. In the packaged run, b≠0 and AxExact=b with A linear imply the displayed backward- and forward-error denominators are nonzero under the standard norm facts, but this nonzeroness is not a separate surface hypothesis of the target.
The contraction condition 0≤λ<1 is required only eventually, although λ→0 is also explicitly assumed.
The proposition does not expose or conclude the lower-level Arnoldi, least-squares, or perturbation facts; they are hidden inside the run and its per-iteration certificates.
ambiguities: The constructor type for LocalDef027 in D037 contains ellipses at its end. Therefore the complete list of inner-solver premises and conclusions packaged into each per-iteration certificate cannot be reconstructed from this packet.
This truncation prevents a fully exhaustive expansion of every assumption inside LocalDef001, but it does not obscure the exact two target recurrences once a run is supplied.
